hero.title: A clean, direct, and distinctive vision.
hero.description: 151 Hair Salon is a space built on a clear vision, inspired by a modern, London-influenced approach: clean, direct, and set apart from traditional salon standards. It is the right place for those who are tired of the usual and are looking for a more honest, professional, and intentional experience. Every choice follows a clear direction: creating something authentic and distinctive.

services.title: Professional services across hair, beauty, and barber.
services.subtitle: Each service is designed to deliver polished, coherent, and recognizable results.

daniela.name: Daniela
daniela.role: Creative Director & Founder of 151 Hair Salon
daniela.bio: A contemporary vision, international influences, and a distinctive aesthetic shape every aspect of my work. I create recognizable results that stand apart from the ordinary. Creative colour and curly haircuts define my signature.

saraHair.name: Sara
saraHair.bio: A clean and natural approach guides my work. Colour, lightening techniques, and balayage are my language, delivering luminous, refined results designed to enhance each individual identity.

sona.name: Sona
sona.bio: I specialize in lamination and nails with a precise, structured approach, supported by a Master qualification in lamination, delivering clean, balanced, and detail-oriented results.

saraBarber.name: Sara
saraBarber.bio: Through clean lines and contrasts between classic and modern, I craft haircuts and beards with precision and character. I deliver refined work where attention to detail sets me apart.
